title: Dental Clinic Human Factors Study
summary: Assessed ergonomic and environmental conditions in a dental clinic.
challenge: Identify workplace conditions that may affect comfort and musculoskeletal risk.
approach: Reviewed working postures, temperature, noise, and practical interventions such as seating, lighting, and micro-breaks.
outcome: Developed recommendations for workplace improvements; no measured post-implementation result is claimed.
learned: Human-centered design is an essential part of operational performance.
